title: ticfac Phase 6: Cloudflare Computer executor
description: SPEC §12 Phase 5 and §8.3-8.7. Computer executor without changing Job* or role contracts; pin the preview dependency; test Workspace persistence, explicit backend routing, cancellation, inspection/adoption, collection, disposal; phase-aware isolate-to-container promotion, container kept hot through RGR/TDD; shadow the Sandbox executor before changing defaults.
